tools.name: access_check
tools.description: Loss-leader URL access, login, and CAPTCHA check. Price: $0.05 USDC. Example: GET /v1/access-check?url=https://example.com

tools.name: api_discovery
tools.description: Discover OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, MCP, and API documentation signals. Price: $0.10 USDC. Example: GET /v1/api-discovery?url=https://example.com

tools.name: change_check
tools.description: Fetch a URL and compare its content fingerprint with the prior KV observation. Price: $0.10 USDC. Example: POST /v1/change-check

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Single-fetch URL intelligence, access checks, commerce signals, and risk. Price: $0.15 USDC. Example: GET /v1/preflight?url=https://example.com&intent=research

tools.name: product_intel
tools.description: Extract product price, availability, add-to-cart, and commerce risk signals. Price: $0.15 USDC. Example: GET /v1/product-intel?url=https://example.com

tools.name: batch_preflight
tools.description: Run standard preflight against as many as 10 URLs in one paid request. Price: $0.35 USDC. Example: POST /v1/batch-preflight

tools.name: premium_preflight
tools.description: Triple-user-agent intelligence with five-hop redirect evidence, retries, access controls, commerce risk, can_proceed, and proof. Price: $0.75 USDC. Example: GET /v1/premium-preflight?url=https://example.com

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: access_check, api_discovery, change_check, preflight, product_intel, premium_preflight · Public sink: change_check, batch_preflight · Destructive: batch_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: access_check, api_discovery, change_check, preflight, product_intel, premium_preflight · Public sink: change_check, batch_preflight · Destructive: batch_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
